# Opening Hours Specification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OpeningHoursSpecification>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

A reified opening-hours window — a day (or set of days), an opening time and a closing time. Projects to [schema:OpeningHoursSpecification.](https://schema.org/OpeningHoursSpecification.) Reification keeps each window's day/open/close paired correctly when several coexist.
